bundleRule.howToGet: Link your CommBank credit or debit card as your recurring payment method during More Telecom NBN sign-up.
bundleRule.realityCheck: Requires paying with a CommBank card; reverting to non-CommBank payment forfeits the $25/mo discount.

bundleRule.label: Save $5/mo on Mobile when linked with iiNet Internet
bundleRule.description: Receive a $5/mo bundling discount on eligible iiNet mobile SIM plans when linked to your active iiNet broadband account.
bundleRule.howToGet: Link your iiNet mobile plan to your internet account via the iiNet Toolbox dashboard.
bundleRule.realityCheck: Discount takes effect on the next billing cycle following successful account linking.

bundleRule.label: Save $5/mo with Exetel Slash My Bill
bundleRule.description: Slash My Bill offers $5/mo off broadband with 1 mobile SIM plan active on the same account.
bundleRule.howToGet: Add an eligible Exetel mobile SIM service to your primary broadband account.
bundleRule.realityCheck: Exetel uses Telstra wholesale network; all services must share the identical residential account.

bundleRule.label: Save $5/mo with Optus Multi-Service Discount
bundleRule.description: Save $5/mo off your account total when combining an eligible Optus home broadband plan with an Optus postpaid mobile plan.
bundleRule.howToGet: Ensure your Optus broadband and postpaid mobile services share the same My Account login and single monthly bill.
bundleRule.realityCheck: Both services must remain in active postpaid standing under the same account holder.
